how_to_use: Paste one phase object at a time into your coding agent. Read AGENTS.md and PRD.md first. Do not start a phase until the previous phase's acceptance_criteria pass.

global_context.stack: Python 3.11, Google ADK, Gemini gemini-2.5-flash, fastmcp, OR-Tools, FastAPI, Firestore (JSON fallback), Telegram Bot API, Cloud Run
global_rules: DEMO_MODE=true must run with only GOOGLE_API_KEY
All external calls go through core/resilience.py
Pydantic models for all agent IO
Check installed google-adk and fastmcp docs for exact import paths before coding, do not guess APIs
No em dashes in docs or copy
Stop and ask if a requirement is ambiguous

phases.name: Scaffold and config
phases.goal: Runnable skeleton with config, models, store and seed data.
tasks: Create repo layout from AGENTS.md
requirements.txt with google-adk, fastmcp, ortools, fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic, httpx, google-cloud-firestore, python-dotenv, pytest
core/config.py loading env with defaults and DEMO_MODE flag
core/models.py: Order, Vehicle, Driver, RoutePlan, Stop, Alert, RecoveryAction, PODResult, TuningUpdate, MissingFields
core/store.py: Firestore implementation and JSON-file implementation behind one interface
core/seed.py plus data/seed.json: 12 orders around Chennai, 4 vehicles, 4 drivers
.gitignore, .env.example
acceptance_criteria: python -m core.seed populates the store in DEMO_MODE
pytest passes for store read/write
No secrets in repo

phases.name: Resilience layer
phases.goal: Reusable self-healing wrapper used by every tool call.
tasks: core/resilience.py: decorator resilient(fallback=None, retries=3, backoff=exp)
On final failure: call fallback, log event to events collection, return a structured Degraded result
Escalation hook that creates an 'needs_human' event
Unit tests with a flaky function that fails N times
acceptance_criteria: Flaky function succeeds after 2 failures
Permanent failure triggers fallback and logs an event
Escalation event appears in the store

phases.name: MCP servers
phases.goal: All tools exposed as MCP servers with demo-mode fallbacks.
tasks: orders_server.py: list_orders, get_order, create_order, update_order, assign_order, list_vehicles, log_event
maps_server.py: geocode, distance_matrix (Routes API computeRouteMatrix), eta_between. Fallback haversine x 1.4
weather_server.py: forecast_for_point using Open-Meteo, rain_risk(lat,lng,window)
notify_server.py: send_message(channel,chat_id,text). Telegram, or console fallback in DEMO_MODE
docs_server.py: save_file, get_file (local folder or GCS)
Wrap every network call with resilient()
acceptance_criteria: Each server starts standalone
Each tool callable from a test client
Maps tool works with no key via fallback
do_not: Put agent logic in MCP servers

phases.name: Intake agent (multi-modal)
phases.goal: Image or PDF or text to validated Order.
tasks: agents/intake.py ADK agent with Gemini multi-modal input
Instruction: extract fields, never invent, return confidence per field
Validation: 6 digit pincode, 10 digit Indian phone, GSTIN format, weight > 0
Return MissingFields with one precise question per gap
On valid order call orders.create_order and geocode address
Add 5 sample invoices and e-way bill images to data/sample_orders/
acceptance_criteria: 4 of 5 sample docs extract correctly
Missing pincode triggers exactly one question
Order appears in store with lat/lng

phases.name: Planner agent
tasks: agents/planner.py with OR-Tools VRP (capacity, time windows, service time)
Distance matrix from maps MCP tool
Apply eta_buffer_min per pincode from tuning collection
Output RoutePlan with stop sequence, ETAs, total_km, unassigned with reasons
Store plan in routes collection
acceptance_criteria: No vehicle over capacity
Hard windows respected or order listed as unassigned with reason
Plan for 12 orders and 4 vehicles in under 15 s
do_not: Call Gemini for the math, use it only to explain the plan

phases.name: Monitor and Recovery agents
phases.goal: Detect problems and fix them automatically.
tasks: agents/monitor.py: loop every MONITOR_INTERVAL_SEC, compare live vs planned ETA, check rain risk, idle detection, emit Alert
Failure injection endpoints: delay vehicle, vehicle breakdown, customer unreachable, address wrong
agents/recovery.py: choose re-sequence, reassign, or reschedule; auto-apply if delay <= AUTO_APPLY_MAX_DELAY_MIN else propose to dispatcher
Log every alert, action, result to events
Trigger Comms agent after any ETA change
acceptance_criteria: Injected breakdown results in reassigned orders and updated ETAs
Injected API failure results in fallback path and an event
At least 80 percent of 10 injected failures recovered in test
do_not: Auto-apply a change that violates capacity or hard windows

phases.name: Comms and POD agents
phases.goal: Conversational messaging and proof of delivery.
tasks: agents/comms.py: dispatcher chat, driver messages, customer ETA updates, replies in English, Hindi, Tamil
Templates are guidance only, the model writes short messages
agents/pod.py: Gemini vision verifies delivery photo, extracts recipient name, confidence score
Low confidence creates needs_human event
On success set order status delivered and store photo via docs MCP
acceptance_criteria: ETA change sends one customer message with new time
Hindi and Tamil replies work for a sample query
POD photo closes an order, a blank photo does not
do_not: Send more than one message per event per customer

phases.name: Feedback agent
phases.goal: Learn from outcomes and visibly improve ETAs.
tasks: core/feedback.py: aggregate predicted vs actual ETA error by pincode and hour band
agents/feedback.py: write eta_buffer_min to tuning, tag failure reasons, propose prompt diffs as text only
Seed historical events so a before and after comparison exists
Expose before and after error metric via API
acceptance_criteria: Running feedback changes buffers for at least 3 pincodes
Next plan uses the new buffers
Measured ETA error drops on seeded data

phases.name: Orchestrator and UI
phases.goal: One entry point and a demo-ready interface.
tasks: agents/orchestrator.py ADK root agent routing to sub-agents
app/main.py FastAPI: /chat, /upload, /plan, /events, /inject/{type}, /feedback/run
app/static: single page with chat, upload, route table (map if time), live event log, 'break something' panel, before/after ETA card
adk web must also load the root agent
acceptance_criteria: Full demo flow works: upload, plan, inject failure, recover, notify, POD, feedback
UI shows event log updating live
No unhandled errors in console
do_not: Add frameworks beyond plain HTML and JS

phases.name: Deploy and docs
tasks: Dockerfile and Cloud Run deploy command in README
README.md A to Z: prerequisites, clone, env, demo mode run, full mode run, ADK web, tests, deploy, demo script, troubleshooting, architecture diagram
Final pass: remove dead code, confirm .env.example, confirm no secrets in git history
Fresh clone test on a clean machine or container following README only
acceptance_criteria: Fresh clone runs in demo mode in under 10 minutes using README only
Cloud Run URL works
Every competition criterion is mapped in README
